body: I was not able to determine what this method is for. The same behavior seems to be built in the FileDialog 🤷‍♂️
FileDialog uses big thumbnails by default. I don't think there is need for separate icons.

This logic is gone. Not sure if it's worth restoring it, it just displays loading animation when thumbnails are loading. I tried to check how it looks and it's difficult to even notice, because everything is either already loaded or loads instantly.

Unused method.

EDIT:
Apparently it exists in FileDialog too 🤔
These don't exist in FileDialog's `update_dir()`. Not sure if important.
So uh, due to how #108147 was implemented, I'm unable to clear the tag icon for thumbnails, so it will always show: I wonder if it's fine .-.
EditorFileDialog has this funny preview sidebar, to show thumbnails in list mode: I did not port it to FileDialog.

Looks like EditorFileDialog had lots of shortcuts.
They'd have to be moved to FileDialog, but that means making them `ui_` actions. I don't think all of them are relevant?

EDIT:
Related: #111460

We need to decide what to do with the side menu.
- Add it to FileDialog - #111120
- Deprecate it - #111162
- Add only to EditorFileDialog

Note that side menu is not compatible with native dialogs and requires a workaround, so the feature is questionable.
This check no longer exists. I could add it as a part of ITEM_MENU_DELETE, which means the action would fail after it is clicked, instead of being entirely hidden.

Mmmmm, this one may be dearly missed by some. Reconsider, and let's think on how.
It's a side bar, too, hmm... I wonder if this and the side menu https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111212#discussion_r2410964820 could be somehow one in the same, within EditorFileDialog.
Nnnnnno... At best they should either appear on top of the thumbnail, or on the left side of the name. The way it is in the screenshot looks bugged.

For reference, this is how it looks without thumbnails: Previously the EditorFileDialog would remove the tag icon (this is how they are called) after generating the preview, but the new API has no callback for that. Now the previews are done by sending an ImageTexture and requesting its data to be replaced, it's done on FileDialog side. Without changing the API (again, see #108147. The old method would allow that), I can connect to `changed` signal of the ImageTexture and forward it to FileDialog. It's weirdly specific and hacky though.

It's a description, no need to sound rushed and breathing for space.

"and hooks in editor callbacks for file previews" sounds so complicated for some reason, but is it also necessary to say? There's nothing exposed to the user in **EditorFileDialog** itself that allows you to "hook in editor callbacks", as well.

